theme_and_archetype.theme: Hybrid (Dark Navy Hero & Chapters / Cream Sections)
theme_and_archetype.rationale: For an Ivy-tier executive education program, the design must exude authority, exclusivity, and prestige. We avoid standard SaaS gradients and instead use deep navy, bone cream, and metallic gold accents with editorial typography to create a bespoke, cinematic narrative rhythm.

serif_italic.usage: Editorial emphasis, second half of headlines, quotes. MUST use italic weight.

display_sans.usage: Primary headings, clean uppercase layout elements.

mono_accent.usage: Eyebrows, small-caps, data points, 'Chapter I' markers. Highly tracked (letter-spacing).

rules.anti_default: Never use Inter or Roboto for headings. Use high-contrast font pairings (e.g. Manrope uppercase mixed with Cormorant Garamond italic).
rules.typesetting: Eyebrows MUST be uppercase and wide tracked. H1 must be tight tracked.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-24, py-32). The design should breathe. Asymmetric layouts are preferred over centered Bootstrap-style grids.
spacing_and_layout.ornamental_corners: Use 1px gold right-angle borders (e.g., top-left, bottom-right) on key image containers and stat blocks to give an 'architectural/blueprint' feel.

marquee_banner.style: Sticky top (z-50). Background: #D4AF37 (Gold) or Dark Navy with Gold text. Must include a 'LIVE pulsing dot' next to 'Admissions Closing Soon'.

navbar.style: Glassmorphism transitioning to solid #040914 on scroll. Epsilon 'E' logo in gold.
navbar.cta: Solid cream background, dark text, sharp corners. No border-radius.

hero.background: Cinematic. Deep Navy (#040914) with an SVG radial gold glow in the center-top. Layer the generated 'premium_navy_gold_bg' subtly if needed.
hero.layout: Center-aligned narrative. Eyebrow in gold mono. Headline: 'Turning technical fluency' (Manrope) / 'into strategic value.' (Cormorant Garamond italic gold).
hero.ctas: Dual CTAs. Primary: Solid cream. Secondary: Outline gold.
hero.stat_blocks: 4 bento-style blocks at the bottom of the hero with 1px faint gold borders, acting as a structural anchor.

chapter_dividers.style: Editorial rhythm. Before major sections, add a block: 'CHAPTER I', 'CHAPTER II'.
chapter_dividers.visuals: DM Mono, widely tracked, flanked by 1px horizontal gold rules.

faculty_section.background: Navy with starfield SVG (absolute positioned white/gold dots of varying opacity).
faculty_section.layout: Lead instructor (Kent) featured prominently on the left (large portrait, gold caption tab 'Lead Faculty').
faculty_section.guest_grid: 4 round circular avatars in a 2x2 or 1x4 grid.
faculty_section.interactions: Guest avatars start grayscale. On hover: transition to full color + subtle scale + gold border glow. Click opens a sleek bio drawer/modal.

usp_cards.style: Dark cards (#0A1128) on a light cream background section to create high contrast. Sharp edges. Ornamental gold brackets on the corners.
usp_cards.typography: Manrope headings, Cormorant Garamond quotes inside.

popup_form.style: Centered modal, dark glass overlay (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). Modal itself is light cream with dark navy typography. Sharp, no rounded corners.

mobile_sticky_cta.style: Visible only on mobile. Fixed to bottom. Two split buttons: 'Call Now' and 'WhatsApp'. High contrast.

apply_wizard.layout: Multi-step form (4 steps). Progress indicator at the top using a gold timeline bar.
apply_wizard.form_elements: Shadcn UI inputs customized to have square corners, 1px dark navy borders, and cream backgrounds. Minimalist, high-end editorial feel.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: MUST use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.entrances: Framer Motion fade-up and subtle Y-axis translate (`y: 20, opacity: 0`) triggered on scroll (`whileInView`).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text color shifts (White to Gold), image grayscale to color, and crisp 1px borders glowing on hover.

instructions_to_main_agent.enforcement_1: You MUST implement the exact color hex codes and font families detailed here. Ensure Google Fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Manrope, DM Mono) are imported in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.enforcement_2: Do NOT use rounded corners on primary structural elements. The aesthetic relies on sharp geometry (rounded-none) and 1px borders, except for the Guest Faculty avatars which MUST be perfectly circular (rounded-full).
instructions_to_main_agent.enforcement_3: Do not skip the starfield SVG background for the Faculty section; implement it using radial gradients or absolute positioned elements.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute based on their role (e.g., data-testid='apply-submit-button').
